footer.slogan: Track your money, see where it goes. Full privacy control in your hands.

home.hero_subtitle: Saku combines expense tracking, budgeting, savings goals, and debt tracking in one super smart dashboard.
home.feat_subtitle: Built with the latest technology to deliver a lightning fast and secure experience.
home.feat_1_desc: Monitor spending trends with interactive charts. Know exactly where your money flows every month.
home.feat_2_desc: Plan your dreams and track your savings progress visually.
home.feat_3_desc: No more forgotten IOUs. Manage debts and receivables transparently.
home.feat_4_desc: Set category budgets and automate monthly bills. No overspending, no late payments.
home.dark_desc: Saku comes with automatically integrated <1>Dark Mode</1> support. Stay focused on managing finances at night without straining your eyes.
home.cta_desc: Free forever. No ads. No subscriptions.

features_page.hero_subtitle: Saku is designed so you can master your cash flow from the very first second you open the app.
features_page.feat_1_desc: No long forms. Just type the amount, pick a category, and you're done in 3 seconds. All balances from various wallets or banks are summarized in one central Dashboard.
features_page.feat_2_desc: Understand your spending habits through interactive data visualizations. Track monthly cash flow trends without the need for boring Excel spreadsheets.
features_page.feat_3_desc: Special features to help you save for your dreams and pay off debts on time.
features_page.feat_3_target_desc: Plan vacations, buy gadgets, or build an emergency fund. Create multiple separate digital piggy banks without needing a new bank account.
features_page.feat_3_debt_desc: Avoid forgetting or feeling awkward asking for money. Manage your debt and receivables history transparently.
features_page.feat_3_recurring_desc: Automate records for monthly bills like Netflix, rent, or internet. Never let a bill go unpaid.
features_page.feat_4_privacy_desc: Your data is encrypted with industry standards (AES-256 via Supabase). We do not sell data to third parties.
features_page.feat_4_dark_desc: Sensitive to light at night? The smart theme system automatically adapts to your OS preferences, providing a glare-free elegant feel.
features_page.feat_4_budget_desc: Set spending limits per category. Saku's smart indicator turns yellow when nearing the limit, preventing you from overspending.
features_page.cta_desc: Stop guessing where your money went. Hundreds of users have switched to Saku.

about_page.about_subtitle: Saku was born with a simple mission: to give you the ease of tracking your money without compromising privacy at all.
about_page.story_p1: Saku was born from personal experience. When we tried looking for a free finance tracking app, we faced two bad choices: an app full of annoying ads, or a "free" app that secretly sold user consumption behavior data.
about_page.story_quote: "Financial data is the most private thing. We refuse to trade it for short-term profit."
about_page.story_p2: No third party should read your coffee purchase history, hospital bills, or where the rest of your monthly salary flows. Saku was built to return that privacy control entirely to your hands.
about_page.pillar_subtitle: Our non-negotiable operational principles. Built for you, on your side.
about_page.pillar_1_desc: Saku stands alone. We are not affiliated with banks, insurance, or online loans. Our algorithms work 100% locally for you.
about_page.pillar_2_desc: All features will never be charged. No subscription traps, no sudden paywalls along the way.
about_page.pillar_3_desc: Clear code of ethics. You have full control over your data, including the right to delete your account and all historical traces forever.

support_page.hero_title_3: or is there anything you want to know?
support_page.cat_1_desc: Basic guide, profile creation, and connecting your entire first wallet ecosystem.
support_page.cat_2_desc: The most effective way to record daily cash flows and set warning limits.
support_page.cat_3_desc: Achieving savings resolutions without creating a new account and billing friends without awkwardness.
support_page.cat_4_desc: Change email, data encryption management, and the option to permanently delete your Saku account.
support_page.support_cta_desc: Don't worry. Our expert technical team is ready to help with any problems you have 24/7.
